name: Pennsylvania Vendor Intake Gate x402
description: HISTORICAL/UNAVAILABLE AppDeploy agent-card artifact. Do not use for runtime discovery. Replacement Floot vendor-intake route is staged but not live until guarded rehost verification completes. Fail-closed Pennsylvania vendor-intake decision tool for autonomous agents. Returns proceed or human_review with typed PA registry, Census address, OFAC candidate-screen, and authoritative RDAP evidence.

skills.name: Pennsylvania Vendor Intake Gate
skills.description: Given a prospective vendor name, U.S. address, and domain, run a bounded four-source intake check and return a machine-actionable proceed or human_review decision. Ambiguous, incomplete, inconsistent, or review-triggering evidence fails closed to human review.
examples: Check whether this Pennsylvania vendor can continue through automated intake.
Pause vendor onboarding if the Pennsylvania registry record is ambiguous or incomplete.
Pause vendor onboarding if Census evidence is incomplete or the submitted and registry addresses differ.
Pause vendor onboarding if OFAC returns a review candidate or its evidence contract is incomplete.
Pause vendor onboarding if RDAP evidence is incomplete, the domain is unregistered, or the registered domain does not plausibly align with the vendor name.

limitations: proceed is a workflow signal, not legal/compliance approval, sanctions clearance, fraud approval, or credit approval
OFAC evidence is candidate-name screening only and does not implement 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis
PA registry matching does not prove current good standing, ownership, or authority to contract
Census matching does not prove physical presence or control of an address
RDAP registration and vendor-name alignment do not prove domain ownership or control
brand/domain heuristics are conservative and can intentionally send legitimate vendors to human review
